seoTitle: How to Add Spotify Music to a Canva Presentation
metaDescription: Embed a Spotify track or playlist into your Canva presentation slides using the Apps library so viewers can play music inline.
intro: Since direct audio file uploads from streaming platforms aren't supported due to licensing, adding Spotify music to a Canva presentation means linking your track through the Apps library instead. This guide covers copying your Spotify share link, embedding it as an interactive widget, and positioning it on your slide.

steps.heading: Copy your Spotify share link
steps.body: In Spotify, use the Share option to copy the URL for your target song or playlist.

steps.heading: Open your presentation project
steps.body: Launch your slide deck in Canva and go to the slide where you want the music player to appear.

steps.heading: Open the Apps section
steps.body: Navigate to the Apps tab in the left-hand sidebar menu.

steps.heading: Use the Embeds tool
steps.body: Find and select the native Embeds application, then paste your Spotify link into the input box.

steps.heading: Position the audio widget
steps.body: Scale and arrange the interactive Spotify player on your slide layer.

steps.heading: Preview your interactive deck
steps.body: Check the presentation to confirm the player controls remain clickable during playback.

faq.question: Can I upload a Spotify song directly instead of embedding a link?
faq.answer: No, direct audio file uploads from streaming platforms are restricted by licensing, so embedding via a share link is the supported method.

faq.question: Will the Spotify player work when I present live?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as the slide format keeps the widget's controls active, viewers should be able to click play during your presentation.

faq.question: Can I embed a full playlist instead of a single track?
faq.answer: Yes, Spotify share links work for both individual songs and full playlists, and either can be embedded the same way.

faq.question: Will the audio play automatically when the slide appears?
faq.answer: Typically the player requires a click to start, so it's worth testing this ahead of time rather than assuming autoplay.
